intelligence.human_view: The question he asked twice — love and like both standing, or one choice point? — is answered by his yes: one row, no dropdown, and the stars are the scale. That is the push-button-simple answer: the feed shows everything at a glance, one row, and the thing you touch to say what a post meant is the ten stars — the house number, in gold, in a circle, with the slow flow around them, lighting up to the one you touch. The heart stays as the Love jewel because love is a jewel, not a number on a scale. Three ways to say the same thing would have been clutter; one row with the stars as the scale is the elegant block he asked for.
intelligence.simple_view: At the bottom of a note, there's one pretty row — ten shiny gold stars in a circle! You tap one and all the stars up to it light up. And the heart stays, because love is a jewel. No hiding things in a little menu!
